seo.title: Architects, Interior Designers & Builders in Kochi, Kerala | Katic Designs
seo.description: Katic Designs is an architecture, interior design and construction studio in Kochi, Kerala and Dubai. Design, build, turnkey homes and property care under one roof.

title: Homes designed
around how you
hero.lead: From first sketch to final walkthrough, we shape houses in the mountains and beyond into spaces that feel considered, warm, and entirely yours.

title: We Build
That Endure.
paragraphs: Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Kochi, Katic Designs is an architecture, interior design, and construction consultancy with a singular focus:

paragraphs.strong: eco-conscious design that performs as beautifully as it looks.

paragraphs: Every project begins with the same discipline — understand the site, harness natural light, and let the land speak first.

values.title: Precision
values.text: Every dimension, material, and detail is considered — nothing is arbitrary, everything earns its place.

values.title: Innovation
values.text: We bring fresh thinking to every brief — blending contemporary methods with time-tested building wisdom.

values.title: Light
values.text: Natural light is our first material. We sculpt it, direct it, and let it define the character of each space.

values.title: Space
values.text: We design how people move, breathe, and feel — not just what they see. Volume, proportion, and flow come first.

values.title: Craftsmanship
values.text: Built to last a generation. We work with skilled artisans and trusted craftspeople who share our standard.

title: Selected
Works
works.lead: A selection of residential, commercial, and civic commissions delivered across Kerala and beyond — each built to our founding principle of eco-conscious design.

explorer.title: Services
explorer.lead: One studio for every stage of your project — design, build, finish and care.

services.name: Architectural Design
services.description: Homes and buildings planned around your site, climate and the way you live — from the first sketch to approved drawings.

services.name: Interior Design
services.description: Calm, practical interiors with materials, furniture and lighting chosen together — made in our own workshop.

services.name: Exterior & Landscape Design
services.description: Facades, gardens and outdoor rooms designed with the building, so inside and outside feel like one place.

services.name: Construction & Execution
services.description: Our own site teams build exactly to the drawing, with clear schedules and quality checks at every stage.

services.name: Turnkey Projects
services.description: One team and one contract, from design and approvals to construction, interiors and handover.

services.name: Renovation & Remodeling
services.description: Give an existing home or building new life — better light, better layout and modern services, keeping the character worth saving.

services.name: Property Care & Maintenance
services.description: Planned maintenance and quick repairs that keep your property looking good and working well, year after year.

stages.title: Discovery
stages.text: Site visit, brief, constraints, and budget — the questions that shape everything after.

stages.title: Concept
stages.text: First massing studies and spatial ideas, tested against light, view, and site logic.

stages.title: Design
stages.text: Detailed drawings, material decisions, and a fully resolved architectural language.

stages.title: Engineering
stages.text: Structural and services design, engineered so the building stands as drawn.

stages.title: Construction
stages.text: On-site execution supervised by our own team, built exactly to the drawing.

stages.title: Interiors
stages.text: Spatial planning, finishes, joinery and lighting that complete the architecture.

stages.title: Handover
stages.text: A guided walkthrough, documentation and keys to a space ready to live in.

title: Signature
Project
signature.text: From the entrance to the last detail, each space is designed to work as one — kitchen, living, dining, and leisure areas sharing a single architectural language.

items.question: What services does KATIC offer?
items.answer: Architectural design, interior design, construction and execution, turnkey projects, renovation, exterior and landscape design, and property care — all under one roof.

items.question: Where do you work?
items.answer: Across Kerala and South India from our Kochi office, and in Dubai and the UAE.

items.question: How does a project start?
items.answer: With a conversation about your site, needs and budget, followed by a site visit and a proposal.

items.question: Can one team handle design and construction?
items.answer: Yes. Our turnkey service covers design, approvals, construction, interiors and handover under one contract.

items.question: How long does a typical home take?
items.answer: Design usually takes 2–4 months and construction 12–18 months, depending on size and finishes.

items.question: Do you support clients after handover?
items.answer: Yes. KATIC Care provides maintenance plans, repairs and ongoing support.
